articles.summary: Maya asks to use your Netflix at 11:02 PM. Text her the password and you end up signed out of your own account. Send a Multifactor link and she’s in without ever seeing it.
articles.title: Two Ways to Share an Account

articles.summary: In our second Lock-In Week we cut Multifactor down to the one thing we care about most: sharing an online account by sending a link, with permissions you choose, a live log of every action, and instant revocation. Try it today.
articles.title: Introducing Multifactor Lite: Share Online Accounts by Sending a Link
